player_signals.summary: Independent AP source (FOX Sports 9:30 PM ET Sep 11) corroborates Todd Archer: Davis needs hip surgery Saturday and is headed for NFL IR. Team has not yet announced the IR transaction. Surgery has not occurred as of this Pulse. RotoWire lists estimated return 10/8/2026; that date is projection, not a confirmed return window.
player_signals.mongo_impact: Davis is already OWNED and occupying the Mongo IR slot. NFL IR would lock four games minimum. Do not start. Do not drop. Do not treat AP corroboration as a completed ESPN IR transaction.
sources: AP via FOX Sports updated 2026-09-11 9:30 PM ET

player_signals.summary: With Davis out, Demercado is the only other RB on Dallas's active roster behind Javonte Williams. Nick Eatman/dallascowboys.com and Archer note Hunter Luepke and possible practice-squad call-up Israel Abanikanda as other options. Schottenheimer still calls Williams the bell cow.
player_signals.mongo_impact: Demercado is OWNED on the Mongo bench. Hold as the Javonte handcuff. Week 1 standalone value remains limited.
sources: RotoWire citing Nick Eatman / Cowboys official site

player_signals.summary: New vs prior Pulse: Kyle Shanahan said Christian McCaffrey played through cramps in the Melbourne win (Nick Wagoner via NBC/Rotoworld). That may explain part of the 14-10 carry split. Black's 14-65-1/5 receiving and Jordan James inactive remain confirmed Week 1 facts.
player_signals.mongo_impact: Black is OWNED on the Mongo bench. Cramp context modestly lowers confidence that the split repeats in Week 2 vs Miami, but he remains SF RB2. Not a drop.
sources: Nick Wagoner via NBC Sports / Rotoworld CMC cramp note
